Backend Engineer (Mid-level) - Orbitline Payments (fictional), Karachi (On-site)

Orbitline processes card payments for 3,000 merchants. We are looking for a backend engineer with 3+ years of professional experience to join our core payments team.

What you will do
- Design, build and operate Python services (FastAPI or Django) that process payment events.
- Model data in PostgreSQL and tune slow queries.
- Use Redis for caching and rate limiting.
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy them to Kubernetes on AWS.
- Own CI/CD pipelines and on-call rotations for your services.
- Take part in system design discussions for high-availability systems.

Required qualifications
- 3+ years of backend development in Python
- Strong experience with FastAPI or Django
- PostgreSQL and SQL query optimization
- Docker and Kubernetes
- CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar)
- System design fundamentals (caching, queues, idempotency)
- Automated testing with pytest

Preferred qualifications
- Kafka or another message broker
- Go
- Payments or fintech domain experience
